testSets.title: Full test 1: Food & Daily Life + Describe a meal you enjoyed

questions.question: What kind of food do you like to eat?
Do you usually eat breakfast in the morning?
Do you prefer to cook at home or eat out?
Describe a meal you really enjoyed.
cueCard: Why you enjoyed it so much

questions.question: Do people in your country eat more at home or in restaurants?
Why do some people like fast food?
Do you think children should learn to cook?

testSets.title: Full test 2: Education & Hobbies + Describe a teacher you remember

questions.question: What subjects did you enjoy most at school, and why?
Do you think it is better to study alone or in a group?
How has technology changed the way people learn in your country?
Describe a teacher who had a big influence on you.
cueCard: Who this teacher was and what subject they taught
What made their teaching style special
How they influenced your attitude toward learning
Why you still remember this teacher

3.topic: The Role of Teachers in Society

questions.question: What qualities do you think a good teacher should have?
Some people say that online courses will replace traditional classrooms. Do you agree?
How important is it for teachers to make lessons interesting rather than just informative?

testSets.title: Full test 3: Science & Technology + Describe a person who taught you a new skill

1.topic: Science and Technology in Everyday Life

questions.question: How much do you rely on technology in your daily routine?
Do you think scientific discoveries have made people's lives easier or more complicated?
What technological invention do you think has had the greatest impact on society?

2.topic: A Person Who Taught You a New Skill

questions.question: Describe a person who taught you a useful skill.
cueCard: Who this person was and how you know them
What skill they taught you and how they taught it
How difficult it was to learn this skill
How this skill has been useful in your life since then

questions.question: To what extent should governments invest in scientific research, even when the benefits are not immediately obvious?
Some people argue that social media has reduced the quality of human interaction. What is your view?
How can societies ensure that technological progress benefits everyone, not just the wealthy?

testSets.title: Full test 4: Globalization & Philosophy + Describe a controversial decision you had to make

questions.question: In what ways has globalization affected the cultural identity of your country?
Do you believe that the widespread use of English as a global language threatens linguistic diversity?
How do you think local traditions can coexist with the pressures of modernization?

2.topic: A Controversial Decision You Had to Make

questions.question: Describe a time when you had to make a difficult decision that not everyone agreed with.
cueCard: What the decision was and what circumstances led to it
What the different perspectives or arguments were
How you ultimately reached your decision
What the consequences of your decision were and whether you would make the same choice again

3.topic: Ethics, Policy, and the Future of Society

questions.question: To what extent should individual freedoms be restricted for the collective well-being of society?
Some philosophers argue that the pursuit of economic growth is fundamentally incompatible with environmental sustainability. How far do you agree with this view?
How should governments balance the need for technological innovation with the ethical concerns that such innovations raise, particularly in areas like artificial intelligence and genetic engineering?

vocabulary.exampleSentence: The food at the restaurant was really delicious.
My new apartment is very comfortable to live in.
Living near a supermarket is very convenient.
I follow the same routine every morning before work.
My favourite season is spring because the weather is mild.
Regular exercise is extremely beneficial for both physical and mental health.
Studying abroad gives students the opportunity to experience different cultures.
Parents have a strong influence on their children's behaviour.
Students are encouraged to participate in extracurricular activities.
There has been a significant increase in the use of public transport.
Many companies are now focusing on sustainability to reduce their environmental impact.
Technological innovation has transformed the way we communicate with each other.
The workforce in this industry is predominantly young and highly educated.
The lack of affordable housing has exacerbated the homelessness crisis in major cities.
Communities often show remarkable resilience in the aftermath of natural disasters.
vocabulary.vietnameseMeaning: Khả năng phục hồi, sự kiên cường

vocabulary.exampleSentence: The pandemic caused an unprecedented disruption to global supply chains.
The juxtaposition of extreme wealth and poverty in the city raises serious ethical questions.
vocabulary.vietnameseMeaning: Sự đặt cạnh nhau, sự tương phản

vocabulary.exampleSentence: Smartphones have become ubiquitous, fundamentally altering social behaviour across all demographics.
vocabulary.vietnameseMeaning: Có mặt khắp nơi, phổ biến

vocabulary.exampleSentence: The shift toward remote work represents a paradigm change in how organisations think about productivity.
The dichotomy between economic development and environmental conservation remains one of the defining challenges of our era.
vocabulary.vietnameseMeaning: Sự phân đôi, sự đối lập

sentences.text: I usually wake up at seven o'clock and have breakfast with my family before I go to work.
sentences.vietnameseMeaning: Tôi thường thức dậy lúc bảy giờ và ăn sáng cùng gia đình trước khi đi làm.

sentences.text: My hometown is a small city near the coast, and it is famous for its fresh seafood.
sentences.vietnameseMeaning: Quê tôi là một thành phố nhỏ gần biển, và nó nổi tiếng với hải sản tươi sống.

sentences.text: I believe that education plays a crucial role in helping young people develop the skills they need to succeed in the modern workplace.
sentences.vietnameseMeaning: Tôi tin rằng giáo dục đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc giúp người trẻ phát triển các kỹ năng cần thiết để thành công trong môi trường làm việc hiện đại.

sentences.text: Travelling to different countries allows people to broaden their horizons and gain a deeper understanding of other cultures.
sentences.vietnameseMeaning: Du lịch đến các quốc gia khác nhau cho phép mọi người mở rộng tầm nhìn và hiểu sâu hơn về các nền văn hóa khác.

sentences.text: Maintaining a balanced diet and exercising regularly are considered essential for leading a healthy lifestyle.
sentences.vietnameseMeaning: Duy trì chế độ ăn uống cân bằng và tập thể dục thường xuyên được coi là thiết yếu để có một lối sống lành mạnh.

sentences.text: While technological advancements have undeniably improved our standard of living, they have also given rise to concerns about data privacy and the displacement of traditional jobs.
sentences.vietnameseMeaning: Mặc dù những tiến bộ công nghệ đã cải thiện mức sống của chúng ta một cách không thể phủ nhận, chúng cũng làm dấy lên lo ngại về quyền riêng tư dữ liệu và sự thay thế các công việc truyền thống.

sentences.text: Governments around the world are under increasing pressure to implement policies that address climate change, yet progress remains slow due to competing economic interests.
sentences.vietnameseMeaning: Các chính phủ trên toàn thế giới đang chịu áp lực ngày càng lớn trong việc thực hiện các chính sách giải quyết biến đổi khí hậu, nhưng tiến độ vẫn chậm do các lợi ích kinh tế cạnh tranh.

sentences.text: The inexorable march of globalization has engendered a paradox whereby cultures are simultaneously becoming more interconnected and yet more fiercely protective of their distinctive identities.
sentences.vietnameseMeaning: Bước tiến không thể ngăn cản của toàn cầu hóa đã tạo ra một nghịch lý trong đó các nền văn hóa đồng thời trở nên kết nối hơn nhưng cũng bảo vệ bản sắc riêng biệt của mình một cách mãnh liệt hơn.

sentences.text: The notion that material prosperity alone can guarantee societal well-being has been increasingly called into question by researchers who advocate for a more holistic measure of progress that encompasses mental health, social cohesion, and environmental stewardship.
sentences.vietnameseMeaning: Quan niệm rằng chỉ riêng sự thịnh vượng vật chất có thể đảm bảo phúc lợi xã hội ngày càng bị các nhà nghiên cứu đặt câu hỏi, những người ủng hộ một thước đo tiến bộ toàn diện hơn bao gồm sức khỏe tinh thần, sự gắn kết xã hội và quản lý môi trường.

sentences.text: Policymakers face the unenviable task of reconciling the imperatives of economic growth with the moral obligation to safeguard the interests of future generations, a challenge that demands not only political will but also a fundamental reconceptualization of what constitutes genuine progress.
sentences.vietnameseMeaning: Các nhà hoạch định chính sách đối mặt với nhiệm vụ khó khăn trong việc dung hòa các mệnh lệnh của tăng trưởng kinh tế với nghĩa vụ đạo đức bảo vệ lợi ích của các thế hệ tương lai, một thách thức đòi hỏi không chỉ ý chí chính trị mà còn sự tái khái niệm hóa căn bản về những gì cấu thành tiến bộ thực sự.

roleplayScenarios.titleVi: Order trà sữa cùng đồng nghiệp
roleplayScenarios.description: Bạn và đồng nghiệp vào tiệm trà sữa. Hãy gọi đồ uống bằng tiếng Anh.

character.name: Barista Emma
character.role: Barista at a bubble tea shop
character.personality: Friendly, patient, speaks clearly and slowly

roleplayScenarios.openingLine: Hi there! Welcome to Boba Bliss! What can I get for you today?
roleplayScenarios.context: The user is ordering bubble tea at a shop. The barista should ask about drink choice, size, ice level, sugar level, and toppings. Keep responses short (1-2 sentences) and natural.
conversationHints: Ask for drink preference
Ask about size and ice/sugar level
Suggest toppings like pearls or jelly
Confirm the order and repeat it back
Give total price and say goodbye

roleplayScenarios.titleVi: Chia sẻ về căn nhà mơ ước của bạn
roleplayScenarios.description: Bạn đang trò chuyện với bạn bè về ngôi nhà mơ ước của mình.

character.name: Friend Alex
character.role: Your close friend having coffee with you

roleplayScenarios.openingLine: Hey! I was just thinking about buying a house someday. What would your dream house look like?
roleplayScenarios.context: A casual conversation between friends about their dream houses. Alex should ask follow-up questions about location, style, rooms, garden, and what makes it special. Keep it friendly and conversational.
conversationHints: Ask about location preference (city, countryside, beach)
Ask about house style and size
Ask about special features or favorite rooms
Share own preference and ask for comparison
Ask about when they hope to achieve it
Wrap up with encouragement

roleplayScenarios.titleVi: Order tại Haidilao với người thương
roleplayScenarios.description: Bạn đang gọi món tại nhà hàng lẩu Haidilao. Hãy giao tiếp với nhân viên.

character.name: Server Lily
character.personality: Professional, helpful, explains menu items when asked

roleplayScenarios.openingLine: Good evening! Welcome to Haidilao! Table for how many? Let me show you to your seat.
roleplayScenarios.context: The user is dining at Haidilao hotpot restaurant. The server helps with seating, explains the menu, takes soup base and ingredient orders. Keep it natural and restaurant-appropriate.
conversationHints: Seat the customer and offer the menu
Ask about soup base preference (spicy, tomato, mushroom)
Suggest popular ingredients and ask what they'd like
Take the full order and ask about drinks
Confirm everything and wish them a great meal

roleplayScenarios.description: Bạn gặp một người cùng fan tại concert. Hãy trò chuyện về idol chung.

character.name: Fellow Fan Jamie
character.role: A fellow fan at the concert
character.personality: Excited, talkative, loves sharing opinions about music

roleplayScenarios.openingLine: Oh my god, I can't believe we're actually here! This is my third time seeing them live! Is this your first time?
roleplayScenarios.context: Two fans meeting at a concert and bonding over their shared love for the artist. Topics: favorite songs, how they became fans, concert experiences, merchandise. Keep it excited and friendly.
conversationHints: Ask about their fan history and how they discovered the artist
Discuss favorite songs or albums
Talk about the concert atmosphere and excitement
Share concert experiences or memorable moments
Talk about merchandise or future concerts
Exchange social media or say goodbye
